create_EPE_function: create a function that computes the end-point error between input_flow and target_flow tensors
use_L1_loss_module: use the L1 module to compute the mean absolute difference between output and target tensors
use_L2_loss_module: use the L2 module to compute the mean L2 norm between output and target tensors
use_L1Loss_class: use the L1Loss class to compute both L1 loss and EPE values for flow estimation
use_MultiScale_loss: use the MultiScale class to compute weighted multi-scale L1 or L2 loss across pyramid levels
